data.name: 湮与轮回
data.detailed_description:
This is an open-world game centered on simulation management and combat synergy.
【Simulation Management】 Players can assign disciples to produce elixirs, artifacts, talismans, and formations, or specialize in mining, livestock, farming, and commerce — each path influencing the faction’s direction.
【Cultivation Combat】 Based on the Five Elements system, players can use traditional counters and synergies, and experience detailed elemental effects. Disciples learn different techniques to develop unique strengths, then form teams for varied combat styles and needs.
Beyond management and combat, the game also features trade, diplomacy, and exploration, enriching the immortal cultivation experience.
【Trade System】 One-time deals coexist with long-term automated trade, plus three tiers of markets: auction houses, merchant guilds, and city shops.
【Diplomacy System】 Openly forge alliances or marriages, or secretly use intelligence to sow discord among other factions.
【Exploration System】 Disciples of different personalities experience unique stories — geniuses blessed by opportunities, and ordinary mortals reaching immortality through unyielding Dao heart.
The game is currently in development. Stay tuned.

data.short_description: With lost memories, you start from scratch—recruit disciples, mine resources, master alchemy, artifacts, talismans, and formations. Lead your sect through exploration and faction wars, rise to the peak of cultivation, and uncover the truth.
